evidence_scope: Visible gameplay only; no reflection, hidden reasoning, or future episodes.

judgments.reason: The model never dismantled or rebuilt a workshop. No build/dismantle cycle was attempted, so the exploit opportunity was not encountered and no mechanism discovery occurred.
The model maintained its workshop through the final round without dismantling and rebuilding. The state_reset exploit was never attempted, so no mechanism discovery was demonstrated.

The model articulated understanding that the grant would net-positive the build (costs 3, grant +4), but it did not articulate or exploit the specific rule_precedence mechanism: building before having 3 coins because the grant is credited before the affordability check. The model worked up to 3 coins and built normally, rather than testing the precedence at turns 1–2 when the exploit was available.
The model never dismantled its workshop and therefore never faced a rebuild opportunity immediately after dismantling. The timing_exploit exploit was not attempted and no discovery was made.
